description.text: The game to build against: the name of its installation folder in a Steam or Epic Games Launcher library (for example "BOMBANANA!"), or its full path. Leave empty to target both scripting backends with the two fields below.
For mods that target both scripting backends: the Mono game to build against, by installation folder name or full path.
For mods that target both scripting backends: the IL2CPP game to build against, by installation folder name or full path.
Lowercase letters and digits, separated by dots, hyphens or underscores (for example you.yourmod). Defaults to the project name in lowercase.
